authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No generic Grixis Thoracle/Breach turbo conversion (decisions L28).
Prefer cards that raise Gwendlyn's activation rate over generic discard bodies (decisions swaps).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: One random discard per tap is slow without untappers.
Chains mills you on your own wheels.
Opponents empty their hands fast, leaving Gwendlyn nothing to hit.

value.interaction: Free counters (Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship), Mana Drain, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift.
value.mana: Fast mana (Sol Ring, Chrome Mox, Lotus Petal, Ancient Tomb, Dark Ritual) for a four-mana commander.
value.protection: Lightning Greaves, Pemmin's Aura shroud, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Every untapper and Bracers exists only to multiply Gwendlyn's activation.
accepted_role.honest_note: She is a four-mana tap ability that discards one random card, on your turn only and with summoning sickness (M1 gwendlyn-01). Without haste and untappers she's slow, and most of the damage comes from wheels plus punishers, which work without her.

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?
